title: Xerox’s Q3 earnings call: our top 5 analyst questions
summary: Xerox’s third quarter was marked by both operational progress and acute challenges, with the market responding negatively to the results. Management highlighted improvements in print revenue trends, organic equipment sales growth, and advancements in production printing, citing the integration of Lexmark’s portfolio as a key contributor.
